## Où j'en suis
`cmd/replay` is written and working: dry-run mode, per-partition ordering, a rejects file for malformed lines, and a hard-coded topic allowlist to `events.replay.v3`. The dry run over the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) completed on the real archive: 18,442,107 events would be replayed, 3,118 schema-v2 lines went to the rejects prefix. PR #233 is open and ready for review with Daniel as reviewer; the real replay and the aggregator backfill have not been run yet.

- [en-cours] Real replay into `events.replay.v3` not started, blocked on Daniel's review of #233.
- [prochaine-étape] After review: run the real replay, then the aggregator with `--backfill` for 2026-11-12; then the ETA for Rachel (Fernhill, Orbitly) by Friday.
- [essai-raté] First dry-run job was OOMKilled at `--batch 50000` (2 GiB limit); re-run at 5k batches peaked at 310 MiB.
- [décision] No age cutoff, replay everything, target `events.replay.v3` only, never produce to `events.v3` from this tool (source: t05)
- [décision] Skipped lines must not be silent: write them to a rejects file in the bucket for the data team (source: t15)
- [décision] No reply drafted to Rachel; the person gives the ETA after Daniel's review (source: t19)
